sections.title: Exposure validation & AppSec
sections.subtitle: Validate exposure. Examine code. Test what matters.

sections.heading: Security from the outside in, and repo to release
sections.body:
End-to-end security, from code to AI: our own products plus specialist services. VajraX is Linkfields' AI-powered exposure validation of your external attack surface. Vector X provides code scanning and supply-chain analysis, repo to release.

Combine these distinct perspectives with offensive testing of AI, LLMs and web applications. Build a clearer view of exposure and give engineering teams findings they can investigate, prioritise and address.

sections.heading: Connect exposure with application risk
sections.description: Our own security IP and specialist testing bring external exposure and software delivery into the same conversation.

sections.heading: Findings your delivery teams can act on
sections.description: Start with an agreed scope and a shared understanding of what is exposed, what is being released and who owns remediation.

items.title: Define the scope
items.description: Identify the external attack surface, application boundaries and relevant repositories. Agree authorisation and testing limits before work begins.

items.title: Validate and examine
items.description: Use exposure validation, code scanning, supply-chain analysis and agreed offensive testing to examine the scoped environment.

items.title: Prioritise the findings
items.description: Review findings with security and engineering stakeholders. Agree severity, ownership and the changes needed to address the risk.

items.title: Recheck the changes
items.description: Review remediation against the original findings. Carry lessons into the next release and revisit exposure as the environment changes.
